title: The suspect believed to be behind the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, Canada made a Roblox game simulating a mall shooting; Roblox says it removed the account (404 Media)
summary: 404 Media: The suspect believed to be behind the mass shooting in Tumbler Ridge, Canada made a Roblox game simulating a mall shooting; Roblox says it removed the account — Roblox said it's “committed to fully supporting law enforcement in their investigation.” — Jesse Van Rootselaar …
